research_scope: Active or imminently active commercial, institutional, industrial, hospitality, and public-works construction in Queen Creek and the nearby southeast Valley, Arizona. Each accepted record identifies an actual builder/general contractor in dated project, owner/developer, city, or contractor reporting. No individual contacts or email addresses are included.
methodology: Accepted only when a dated source expressly names the contractor/GC/CMAR and a current construction, groundbreaking, or future delivery signal. Official agency and owner/developer links are included where the dated report supplies them. Confidence reflects the directness and recency of that evidence.

results.project: Signal Butte Water Treatment Plant expansion
results.project_location: 84 acres north of Elliot Road and east of Signal Butte Road, Mesa, AZ
results.dated_current_signal: 2026-01-16 — construction reached the major milestone of completing a new 8MG potable-water reservoir; Phase I was scheduled for October 2026 and Phase II for early summer 2027.
results.evidence: Dated project report expressly identifies McCarthy Building Companies as general contractor and Black & Veatch as engineer of record.
results.likely_apex_grid_fit: High: municipal utility/site-civil coordination, drainage, utilities, construction-phase engineering, and multi-phase delivery support.
